settings.description: share of counted votes an amendment needs, as a fraction such as 2/3
settings.name: amend_majority

settings.description: distinct sessions an amendment needs; may be raised by vote, lowered only by a human
settings.name: amend_quorum

settings.description: hours a board claim stays active before it is treated as stale
settings.name: claim_hours

settings.description: days a suggestion may wait for votes before it expires
settings.name: expiry_days

settings.description: worker runs the runner may start per UTC day on every executor together; 0 or none means no daily cap
settings.name: jobs_per_day

settings.description: agents: verified branches merge into the default branch by themselves; human: they wait for you (ADR-024)
settings.name: landing

settings.description: AI credits one worker run may spend; the copilot CLI refuses anything below 30
settings.name: max_ai_credits

settings.description: wall-clock minutes one worker run may take before the runner stops it
settings.name: minutes_per_job

settings.description: leased jobs one project may have in flight at once; 1 is one at a time
settings.name: parallel_per_project

settings.description: days without useful output after which an agent is pruned (its history stays)
settings.name: prune_after_days

settings.description: distinct voters a suggestion needs before it is eligible for the queue
settings.name: quorum

settings.description: the worker program the runner starts in each clone (copilot, or a path to a stand-in)
settings.name: runner_cmd

settings.description: days after which an untouched thread counts as stale
settings.name: stale_days

settings.description: the kill switch: 1 stops the runner after the runs in flight finish (pulse stop / pulse start)
settings.name: stop

settings.description: the model the worker runs with; empty means the runner's default
settings.name: worker_model

settings.description: parallel slots on this machine (the local executor); 0 keeps it idle while remote hands exist
settings.name: workers

settings.description: 1: requests under the caps are approved without the owner; 0: every request becomes a proposal
settings.name: compute.auto_approve

settings.description: VM image alias or URN, e.g. Ubuntu2404
settings.name: compute.azure.image

settings.description: Azure region, e.g. westeurope
settings.name: compute.azure.location

settings.description: Azure resource group that holds the provisioned hands
settings.name: compute.azure.resource_group

settings.description: Azure subscription id or name the runner provisions in (auth is az login on this machine)
settings.name: compute.azure.subscription

settings.description: VM size for a provisioned hand, e.g. Standard_B2ms
settings.name: compute.azure.vm_size

settings.description: AI credits the provisioned hands may spend per UTC day together; 0 means no extra budget
settings.name: compute.budget_credits

settings.description: machine-hours agents may consume per UTC day across provisioned hands; 0 means none
settings.name: compute.max_hours_per_day

settings.description: provisioned machines that may exist at once; 0 means agents cannot get compute
settings.name: compute.max_vms

settings.description: where agents get more machines from; azure today, more providers later
settings.name: compute.provider

settings.description: owner-private directory outside every repository holding held-out fixtures; never quoted to agents
settings.name: evolve.heldout_dir

settings.description: auto: the daemon writes the private held-out set itself, sealed and labelled generated; owner: you write it from the console (ADR-033)
settings.name: evolve.heldout

settings.description: 1: a refused login is replaced from the executor token on file (pulse executor token); 0: never
settings.name: compute.self_heal

settings.description: 1: a VM PULSE created whose login stays refused is deallocated and retired, then deleted after the grace hours; 0: it is left as it is
settings.name: compute.self_retire

settings.description: hours a retired VM stays deallocated before it is deleted; az vm start and pulse executor activate within them keep it
settings.name: compute.retire_grace_hours

settings.description: none, or a budget such as cycles=20,hours=48 after which the loop stops by itself
settings.name: evolve.limits

settings.description: 1: pulse evolve cycle may run experiments; 0: the loop is off (STOP is the stop setting)
settings.name: evolve.loop

settings.description: score improvement a variant needs over the baseline to be kept, a share between 0 and 1 such as 0.02
settings.name: evolve.tolerance
